tools.name: identify_medicinal_plant
tools.description: Identifies a medicinal plant from a photograph using our 1,203-class Hybrid CNN–ViT model. Applies dual-threshold uncertainty gating (confidence < 0.60 or entropy > 0.45) to automatically route out-of-distribution or ambiguous inputs to the Pl@ntNet API fallback.

image_path.description: Absolute or relative filesystem path to the query plant image (.jpg, .jpeg, .png).

organ_hint.description: Optional prior knowledge of the plant organ depicted in the image.

tools.name: explain_plant_prediction
tools.description: Generates multimodal Explainable AI (XAI) visual diagnostics for a medicinal plant image. Computes CNN micro-texture Grad-CAM on the terminal convolution layer, ViT macroscopic Attention Rollout across all 6 Transformer encoder blocks, a fused composite saliency map, and the Anatomical Focus Score (AFS). Saves a publication-quality 4-panel diagnostic figure to disk.

image_path.description: Absolute or relative filesystem path to the query plant image.

target_class.description: Optional target species name (common or binomial) for targeted Grad-CAM saliency. If omitted, targets the model's top prediction.

output_dir.description: Directory where the 4-panel diagnostic plot should be saved. Defaults to 'reports/xai_diagnostics'.

tools.name: get_plant_information
tools.description: Retrieves an exhaustive botanical, taxonomic, phytochemical, and pharmacopoeial profile for a given medicinal plant from our curated WHO/IMPPAT/NCCIH knowledge database. Accepts common vernacular names (e.g. 'Tulsi', 'Aloe Vera', 'Holy Basil') or scientific binomials.

species_name.description: Common vernacular name or binomial scientific name of the medicinal plant.

tools.name: get_medicinal_uses
tools.description: Queries traditional medical systems and clinical trial evidence for a specific plant. Retrieves Ayurvedic pharmacodynamics (Rasa, Guna, Virya, Vipaka, Prabhava, Dosha Karma), Siddha/Unani indications, peer-reviewed clinical trials (CTRI, NCT, IRCT), bioactives, or safety/contraindications.

species_name.description: Common or scientific name of the medicinal plant.

system.description: Specific medical framework or evidence category to filter by.
